Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis and visualization, with skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and dashboard creation.

I’d be glad to support your LightningChart project by helping organize and prepare data for clear, interactive, and real-time visual outputs. I’m comfortable working with large data sets, building structured dashboards, and turning complex data into visuals that are easier to interpret.

While my background is centered on analytics and visualization, I’m interested in learning more about your LightningChart workflow and how you want to integrate your data sources for earthquake early detection.

Could you share which data sources and streaming format you’re using for the real-time charts?
